title: Rolling aerobic, tired legs
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 1h50 at 142-152bpm, rolling, ~450m D+, cadence 172+, run the descents relaxed.
GYM: Copenhagen 2x30s/side.
FUEL: 1 flask Tailwind from min 30.
GARMIN: ~140-160.
STOP RULE: Sunday HRV under 55 or quads sore after Saturday = 1h20 flat at the same HR.
WHY: back-to-back on tired legs is the VWT second-half stimulus; +15 (+14%) recovers Friday's 18 shortfall, the HR cap stops it becoming a second long run.
